findings.title: Model Router Call Log Missing

evidence.observation: Model router reports call_log_exists as false for configured log path /opt/starship-endeavour/core/model-router/call_log.jsonl.

proposed_action.description: Ensure the model router creates and writes invocation metrics and traces to call_log.jsonl.

findings.expected_benefit: Restores call-level observability and log metrics auditing across routed model operations.

findings.title: Unimplemented Phase 5 Features in Research Commands

evidence.observation: Multiple Phase 5 TODO markers found for authorization checking via Supabase, integration with decision_to_memory, and general implementation stubs.

proposed_action.description: Implement the planned Phase 5 authorization checks and memory integrations or document their roadmapped schedule.

findings.expected_benefit: Completes research command integration and enforces Supabase-backed authorization.

findings.title: Unimplemented Quality Anomalies Table Query

evidence.observation: Hardcoded empty list with TODO placeholder to query quality_anomalies table.

proposed_action.description: Implement database query to fetch records from quality_anomalies table instead of returning a static empty list.

findings.expected_benefit: Enables actual anomaly analysis in the quality forecasting module.

findings.title: Direct Gemini Call Bypass in Emergency Alerts

evidence.observation: Direct call to call_gemini using GEMINI_API_KEY environment variable rather than delegating through the model router.

proposed_action.description: Route emergency alert LLM queries through the centralized model router using an appropriate task type.

findings.expected_benefit: Ensures central policy governance, metrics tracking, and failover support for emergency alert prompts.
